title: controller
description: Control IC: PWM / LLC / PFC controllers, gate drivers, digital (PMBus) controllers, voltage references, current-sense amplifiers, optocoupler feedback, hot-swap controllers, isolated amplifiers. Shape and field list derived from the published datasheet sections of mainstream parts (TI UC384x / UCC256xx / UCC28xxx / TPS40xxx; Analog Devices ADP1051 / LTC family; Onsemi NCP162x; Infineon ICE5xx; Renesas ZSPM family). A controller PEAS document MUST carry either designRequirements (pre-librarian seed) or manufacturerInfo (resolved real part); both may be present after the librarian binds a seed to a part.

designRequirements.description:
What the design needs from a controller. Lives at PEAS root inputs.designRequirements (not inside the controller branch payload). The stencil emits this pre-librarian; the librarian uses it as the search constraint to bind a real part; it is retained post-binding as the spec the part met.

Ideal-simulation floor: `category` is universally required. For switching-converter categories (pwmController, llcController, pfcController, dualPwmController, phaseShiftController, syncRectifierController, digitalController) `intendedTopology` and `switchingFrequency` are additionally required so a behavioural switch model can be instantiated from the seed alone. Non-switching categories (gateDriver, voltageReference, currentSenseAmplifier, optocouplerFeedback, isolatedAmplifier, hotSwapController, secondaryFeedbackController) only require `category`.

channelCount.description: Required number of independent PWM / driver channels.

supplyVoltageAvailable.description: Bias-rail voltage range the design can offer the controller's VCC pin, in volts.

switchingFrequency.description: Switching-frequency range the design needs the controller to support, in Hz. The chosen part's electrical.switchingFrequency range must contain this interval. Required for switching-converter categories so an ideal behavioural switch can be simulated from the seed.

minimumGateDriveCurrent.description: Peak gate-drive current the controller must source (and sink) to switch the chosen power device within the required transition time, in amperes.

maximumQuiescentCurrent.description: Upper bound on the controller's quiescent supply current, in amperes (drives standby and no-load efficiency budget).

requiredProtections.description: Protections the controller must implement on-die.

requiredTelemetry.description: Telemetry channels the controller must report (only meaningful when digitalInterfaceRequired is not 'none').

operatingTemperature.description: Required operating junction-temperature envelope, in degrees Celsius.

datasheetInfo.description: Manufacturer-published data for a resolved controller part. Populated by the librarian; absent on pre-librarian seeds.

pins.description: Canonical pin map. Required for stencils to wire the controller into a TAS circuit.

function.description: What the controller does. Mirrors the 'Description / Features' page of every controller datasheet.

intendedTopologies.description: Topology families this controller is designed for. Empty for non-converter parts (voltage references, current-sense amps).

frequencyJitterSupported.description: True if the controller implements frequency dithering for conducted-EMI reduction.

electrical.description: Operating electrical characteristics. Mirrors the 'Electrical Characteristics' table of the datasheet.

supplyVoltageAbsoluteMax.description: Absolute-maximum VCC, in volts (from the abs-max table).

quiescentCurrent.description: Typical operating supply current, in amperes.

startupCurrent.description: Supply current before UVLO release (start-up current draw on VCC), in amperes.

switchingFrequency.description: Programmable switching-frequency range, in Hz. Omit for non-switching parts.

referenceVoltage.description: Internal bandgap / feedback reference, in volts.

referenceTolerance.description: Initial accuracy of the reference voltage, as a fraction (0.01 = 1%).

softStartTime.description: Internal / externally programmed soft-start ramp duration, in seconds.

leadingEdgeBlanking.description: Leading-edge blanking time applied to the current-sense input, in seconds.

deadTime.description: Dead time between complementary outputs (half-bridge / full-bridge / synchronous), in seconds. Omit for single-ended controllers.

errorAmplifier.description: Internal error-amplifier characteristics (needed for compensator design).

transconductance.description: Forward transconductance gm, in siemens (transconductance amplifiers only).

openLoopGain.description: DC open-loop gain in dB (voltage amplifiers).

outputSourceCurrent.description: Peak source current of the amplifier output, in amperes.

outputSinkCurrent.description: Peak sink current of the amplifier output, in amperes.

gateDrive.description: Gate-driver output characteristics (mirrors the 'Output Stage' / 'Gate Driver' section).

sourceCurrentPeak.description: Peak source current into the gate, in amperes.

sinkCurrentPeak.description: Peak sink current from the gate, in amperes.

driveVoltage.description: Gate-drive output voltage swing (typically tracks VCC or an internal clamp), in volts.

riseTime.description: 10% to 90% rise time into a specified test capacitance, in seconds.

fallTime.description: 90% to 10% fall time into a specified test capacitance, in seconds.

testCapacitance.description: Load capacitance at which riseTime / fallTime / propagationDelay are specified, in farads.

protection.description: One on-die protection event with its threshold, hysteresis, and recovery behaviour.

threshold.description: Trip threshold in native units of the monitored quantity (V for voltage-class, A for current-class, degrees Celsius for temperature, fraction for duty-class).

hysteresis.description: Hysteresis in the same units as threshold.

restartDelay.description: Auto-restart / hiccup delay before re-engagement, in seconds (when mode is autorestart or hiccup).

pin.description: One pin of the controller. The combination (number, name, function) is canonical and must be unique within a part.

absMaxVoltage.description: Absolute-maximum voltage at this pin, in volts.

absMaxCurrentSource.description: Absolute-maximum source current at this pin, in amperes.

absMaxCurrentSink.description: Absolute-maximum sink current at this pin, in amperes.

digitalInterface.description: Digital communication interface, if any. A part with no digital interface omits this object entirely.

addressPinCount.description: Number of strap pins used to set the address.

supportedCommands.description: PMBus command codes implemented by the part, as canonical command names (e.g. 'READ_VOUT', 'READ_IOUT', 'STATUS_WORD').

maxClock.description: Maximum SCL clock frequency, in Hz.
Maximum SCK clock frequency, in Hz.

mechanical.description: Mechanical package data for the controller. Extends the shared datasheetInfoMechanical with an explicit packageType code.
